name: Shima (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shima city emblem in green: a disc pierced by white curved strokes, like a stylised letter S.
history: Municipal flag of Shima, a city in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 10 February 2005.

features.role: Shima city emblem — a disc pierced by white curved strokes, like a stylised letter S
